statement: Star signs are a big deal and prioritizing the right ones gives roughly an extra 10-15% out of your characters.
The star sign picked at character creation is bottom-of-the-barrel compared to the ones you unlock later.
Interact with the telescope NPC at the top of the tree in Where the Branches End (wood mushroom area) to unlock star sign viewing.
You start with one star sign page called Cronis; a second page called Hydron unlocks later.
You must unlock the star sign ability on every character; the unlock is not account-bound, but unlocked star signs are account-bound.
First major star sign to rush is Cronis Cosmos, which lets you equip two star signs at once.
After Cronis Cosmos, beeline to near the end of the page to the two big star signs.
The Forsaken gives 6% fight AFK gains at the cost of -80% HP and -50% defense.
The Forsaken is mostly used for 3D printing or mob farming in worlds you are overleveled for.
OG Skiller is an S tier star sign thanks to all-skill prowess and skill AFK gain percent.
He always uses OG Skiller in his skilling guides.
Ned Kelly gives +6% defense and 2% weapon power; not huge but nice early game.
Mount Eerus gives +10% chance to not consume food and +15% food effect, good for late or early food-effect builds.
Mount Eerus plus the Crabcake card with normal health food means you stop consuming food, saving money.
Big Comatose and Silly Snoozer give AFK gains for fighting or skilling and are staples for AFK gains.
Grim Reaper gives only 2% mob respawn but is an asset for active farming.
Unlock Dwarfo Beardus (mining), Hipster Logger (chopping), Pisces (fishing) and Shoefly (catching) before Hydron; very important for 3D printing and skilling.
The four skilling star signs are very important especially for 3D prints or skilling generally.
To unlock Hydron you must unlock a certain set of star signs along the path; you are only missing about two.
Fallen Titan gives boss damage and crit chance and helps all around; get it to finish the Hydron requirement.
Blue Hedgehog gives a very slim chance for a ring drop, plus one to Ludi; kind of trash.
There are not enough star points to unlock everything, so only get the recommended constellations and do not spend points elsewhere.
Hydron is late-game constellations; some star signs have level requirements to use.
Rush Hydron Cosmos first, a big upgrade as it lets you equip three star signs instead of two.
Trapezoidberg gives +20% critter and +10% trap efficiency, fantastic for traps; next to Hydron Cosmos.
Get unlocks up to Sergeant Snoozer Major, last Hydron upgrade; gives 4% AFK gains instead of 2%, requires level 100.
The star sign next to Sergeant Snoozer Major is impossible to get as of now.
Comatose Major, just below, gives 4% skill AFK and requires level 90.
The Feisty gives 6% total damage.
Bull Work gives +20% total damage at -12% movement speed; arguably one of the best star signs.
Later game speed potions push movement speed over 212%, and AFK gains cap at 200%, so Bull Work is a no-brainer.
Kolingo gives +15% multikill, great for 3D prints.
Grim Reaper Major gives 4% mob respawn, fantastic for active farming.
For skilling use skilling efficiency signs (Dwarfo Beardus, Hipster Logger, etc.) followed by Comatose Major and OG Skiller; solid for 3D prints and skilling.
For active farming use Grim Reaper Major and Grim Reaper for 6% mob respawn, plus Mount Eerus to save pots and food.
For 3D print mob materials use Sergeant Snoozer Major, Silly Snoozer, and Bull Work or Kolingo or Forsaken depending on need.
There is a chip in world 4 that doubles all equipped star signs, an easy 15-20% increase.
Use the wiki link to find where constellations are located; A, B, C refer to the world, e.g. A1 is world 1.
Outro with Discord, guild signup and subscriber requests; no game claims.
